review_kind: Independent pre-model scientific and code review
authorization: Proceed to method freeze and six-combination preflight; model requests remain conditional on that preflight passing.

checks.detail: Read every card, rationale, and ambiguity audit. E expressly requires normalized whole-response reference equality; V expressly requires either whole Boolean token while permitting reference disagreement; U positively grants full credit to arbitrary strings/prose. All quoted evidence is an exact substring.

Twelve unique descriptions cross four language families with E/V/U once each: four per class. The 24 nonnull cells repeat six semantic/program combinations; the documents forbid iid generalization and new upstream bug claims.

E plus V is class E only in evaluation; ordered raw obligations remain unchanged. U is administrative abstention, excluded from binary TN/FP denominators. Invalid output is INVALID, never a successful U.
The analytical matrix is correct for necessary full-credit implications only. No_alarm does not establish complete reward correctness or rule out under-rewarding. U has no formal binary static label.

The rule baseline has substantive reference/correctness, token, scoped-negation, permission, format-only and output-representation rules, six balanced development cards, and documented limitations. No test-ID lookup or deliberately weakened path was found. No held-out predictions were executed in this review.

Inputs contain description, opaque administrative task ID, empty notes, and fixed profile only. Fresh ephemeral read-only working directory, ignored user configuration, project-doc disabling, exact schema and unchanged event audit reject tool/action traces. Compiler/validator admit or reject without repair; malformed/partial failed outputs stay INVALID.

freeze requires this exact reviewed method hash mapping. Preflight runs exactly six standard analyze combinations, checks expected determinate results, source certificates and native counterexamples, preserves failure, and does not auto-fix. Rules and all twelve requests require passed preflight for the same freeze. Single-batch/write-new gates prevent outcome-driven overwrites or retries.

Read exact-source native subprocess wrapper and all analyzer call sites. Native rewards enter only independent evaluation; analyze accepts only source and selected contract, check_witness additionally only candidate/reference. Independent predicate truth is implemented separately from the preserved oracle.

Gold V with truthiness is buggy on banana, but an E-only extraction can return False versus True, which does not violate V. certify_global records gold_predicate_violated for every returned witness; supported_correct does not credit that coincidental TP without a returned gold-violating witness. Extra unjustified witnesses are separately counted.

fixed_E, fixed_V and fixed_null are explicitly labeled assumed policies, not evidence-qualified extractors. Reference is researcher-assigned. Raw class accuracy, binary outcomes and witness-supported outcomes remain distinct.

Read-only hash inspection checked all 47,285 prior snapshot files with zero mismatches; all five dependency pins and two source-origin pins match. The two copied real source definitions match the prior inputs; token-only source matches its frozen unit-test literal. No old files were changed by this reviewer.

resolved_before_freeze: Aligned provenance and labels with the opaque administrative ID actually required by the unchanged schema.
Bound freeze approval to exact current method file hashes.
Made necessary-full-credit-only scope explicit, including under-rewarding counterexamples.
Handled failed/rejected partial JSON without aborting evaluation or repairing output; added two infrastructure regression cases.

owner_test_evidence.note: Read the owner-produced logs; reviewer did not rerun tests.

limits: Natural-language labels are a defensible researcher reading, not machine-proved semantic implication or a soundness theorem.
Documented mutual author blinding is a provenance claim; this independent reviewer intentionally read both descriptions and rules.
Only twelve authored descriptions, four linguistic families, three source definitions and six nonnull combinations are studied. Do not count repeated cells as independent discoveries.
The deterministic baseline is bounded and trained on six authored development cards. Results compare these frozen methods on this set, not all rule systems or general language understanding.
The default model service may not expose exact identity, temperature or seed; transport metadata must preserve that uncertainty.
Static review does not predict that runtime preflight or model transport will succeed. On preflight failure preserve artifacts and stop; do not tune method or analyzer.
